form.label: Analytics
form.description: Track how much Claude Desktop is used across your machines, and how heavy it runs.

search.query: | metadata type=hosts index=claude | sort host | fields host

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype=claude:desktop:main OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:mcp OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:web OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork:service)
`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ sourcetype=claude:desktop:main "[CCD] Initialized with version" | stats count
| bucket _time span=1d | stats dc(_time) as days
`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ sourcetype=claude:desktop:mcp "method=\"initialize\"" | dedup _time host | stats count
`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ sourcetype=claude:desktop:main "[process-memory]" | rex field=_raw "tree_rss_sum=(?<rss>\d+)MB" | stats avg(rss) as avg_rss | eval avg_rss=round(avg_rss)

panel.title: Event volume over time by host
Memory usage over time (Resident Set Size by host)

search.query: `claude_index` host=$host_tok$ sourcetype=claude:desktop:main "[process-memory]" | rex field=_raw "tree_rss_sum=(?<rss>\d+)MB" | timechart span=1h avg(rss) as rss_mb by host

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype=claude:desktop:main OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:mcp OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:web OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork:service) | eval component=coalesce(component, mcp_server, "(none)") | stats count as events dc(host) as hosts by component | sort - events | head 25

`claude_index` host=$host_tok$ (sourcetype=claude:desktop:main OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:mcp OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:web OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork OR sourcetype=claude:desktop:cowork:service) | eval level=lower(coalesce(log_level, log_level_b)) | eval is_launch=if(match(_raw,"\[CCD\] Initialized with version"),1,0) | rex field=_raw "appVersion:\s*.(?<ver>[0-9.]+)." | eval is_err=if(level="error",1,0) | stats count as events sum(is_launch) as launches sum(is_err) as errors latest(ver) as version max(_time) as last_seen by host | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | eval error_rate=round(errors*100.0/events,2)."%" | table host version launches events errors error_rate last_seen | sort - events
